text:
Ana Gomez: Heads-up, LATAM marketplace reviewer for EdgePartner wants the evidence bundle localized: Spanish/Portuguese affidavit + SOC2 control summary in Portuguese for BR listing. They also asked for pen-test attestation referencing local tax ID for the SI. cc @Ravi Shah @Nora Kim :flag-br: :flag-ar:
Ravi Shah: Wow, ok. So tasks: translate SOC2 summary, provide pen-test attestation, and include SI tax ID on the witness doc. Do we have translators for legal artifacts?
Nora Kim: Legal can produce bilingual affidavit templates. We should avoid full SOC2; do a 1-page Portuguese control summary + signed attestation. Legal: @legal-sig?
legal-sig: Confirmed. We can create a bilingual affidavit (EN/PT) and include the SI tax ID (RFC/CNPJ equivalent). Notarization: Brazilian reviewers sometimes ask for apostille. We can e-notarize and include instructions for local apostille via SI if required.
Carlos (EdgePartner): EdgePartner will provide their CNPJ and can co-sign witness statement. They prefer Redwood to supply the firmware hash and attestation in both EN/PT.
Ravi Shah: Artifact packaging: presigned links, short TTLs. artifact-bot, can you create a manifest with TTLs and a README note about localization?
artifact-bot: Manifest created: items -> soc2-summary-pt.pdf (14d), pen-attestation-pt-en.pdf (30d), firmware.sha256.txt (7d), si-taxid.txt (30d). Manifest ID: latam-edge-1812349998. README-latam.md included.
Ana Gomez: Ops, please run hash on the appliance image for release v2.0.1 and paste into firmware.sha256.txt. Use this command:
```
sha256sum appliance-image.bin > firmware.sha256.txt
cat firmware.sha256.txt
```
Ravi Shah: I'll run the hash and upload. Nora, legal will you draft bilingual affidavit and witness template that includes CNPJ field?
legal-sig: Drafting now. Will include bilingual headings, hash field, timestamp, signatory block, and a line: "CNPJ do parceiro: <value>". We'll route for e-sign. Expect draft in ~6h.
Carlos (EdgePartner): We'll provide CNPJ: 12.345.678/0001-90 and sign once routed. Also ask: marketplace asked for FIPS-validated crypto statement for Brazil gov catalog. Do we have that?
Nora Kim: We don't have FIPS cert, but we can provide a statement of cryptographic algorithms in use and HSM vendor attestation. Legal recommends adding mitigation note if reviewer requires FIPS.
Ravi Shah: Uploaded firmware.sha256.txt to manifest (hash: b4c2d1...). All other files pending. Timeline: reviewer deadline in 2 business days. Team, please prioritize translations + legal signoff.
Ana Gomez: Thanks all. If apostille becomes mandatory, we'll hand off to EdgePartner to obtain locally. Will post updates here. :white_check_mark:
